title: Do Employees Cheer for Private Equity? The Heterogeneous Effects of Buyouts on Job Quality
authors: Will Gornall; Oleg R. Gredil; Sabrina T Howell; Xing Liu; Jason Sockin
eligible_reason: Staggered binary treatment: post-LBO indicator (postPE = quarter after deal quarter DealYQ) for Glassdoor employers acquired in buyouts at many different quarters (2010-2016), with ~108,000 never-acquired firms as controls. Table 2 and Table 3 Panel A regress satisfaction ratings and pay outcomes on postPE with company FE and industry-by-quarter FE, no controls, clustered by company (14 static specs). Figures 3 and 4 are unstacked relative-quarter event studies with the same FE (11 specs). HOWEVER the package ships only scrambled mock-up data (README), so the specifications are eligible in design but cannot be replicated without the proprietary Glassdoor/Pitchbook data.
design_notes: Firm-quarter panel 2008Q1-2019Q4 of Glassdoor employers; treatment = leveraged buyout (Pitchbook) at DealYQ; main_sample_pe2 keeps vanilla LBO, public-to-private and corporate divestiture deals plus never-treated firms (management buyouts and growth equity handled separately in Table 11). postPE constructed as gr_ryq > DealYQ (Replication_Build_FinalReg.do line 675/968). Mock rev file: 383,054 firm-quarters, 113,694 employers, 4,752 switchers, 485 'always treated' (deal before 2008 or at sample start), 108,457 never treated; DealYQ has 28 distinct quarters (200-227 = 2010Q1-2016Q4) in the cq file. Heterogeneity tables interact postPE with leverage terciles/continuous leverage (Table 5), unemployment (6), tenure/education/manager (7-10); Table 11 uses multiple ownership-change treatments; Table 12 uses a matched sample with event_yq FE. Pay regressions merge quarterly pay outcomes (logbase, logbonus_zeros, earnsPP) from a separate file.
estimators_reported: TWFE static reghdfe with company and industry-quarter FE (Tables 2, 3A)
unstacked event studies with relative-quarter dummies (Figures 3-4)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: 28 distinct DealYQ values in the mock cq file (2010Q1-2016Q4); real data cohort count not verifiable.
always_treated_note: 485 employers have postPE = 1 in all observed quarters (deals before their first review).
reports_modern_estimator_note: Full-text flags cite Goodman-Bacon, Sun-Abraham, Baker et al. and Cengiz et al., but no modern estimator appears in the code.
